The '''Glonnk Clan Fortress''' was a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]]. It was a stronghold of the [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Glonnk clan]], located close to the obliterated [[Norgk clan]] [[Norgk Clan Fortress|fortress]].<ref name="EGTPM" />
